samālikhet saṃpūjya aṣṭottaraśatam japtvā prāśayet sādhya
pūrvakam tad kṣaṇāt sva vaśam yāti yāvat
sitam maṃtritam vrahman yantra sādhya samanvitam dhṛtvā gacchet sa
bhā madhye sabhā tasya vatrāṃbhava iti at yat smṛtvā japet maṃtraṃta
t t siddhiḥ ca tad kṣaṇā tathā ākarṣaṇa karmāṇi vicitrā
ṇivadāmite pūrvavat yaṃtram ālikhya sādhya nāma samanvitam
vīja akṣarāṇi sarvāṇi māyāvījena veṣṭayet maṃtra aṃte vi
likhet vrahman sādhyam ākarṣaya iti ca pūrvavat pūjayet yaṃtram sa
mad aham vidhi pūrvakam rakta puṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya siddhānnam tu nive
pṛ0 19a
ṣphalam guḍe proktam tad mānam nālikerakam muṣṭu mātram marī
caṃsyā tad arddham saiṃdhavam rajaḥ tad arddham jīrakam tadyāt kuḍavam go
ghṛtam viduḥ go kṣīreṇa sva mātreṇa saṃyojya kamalāsanamaṃ
agninā yaced evam siddhānnam idam īritam amṛtena sṛ
maṃsa akṣāt vighneśasya priya avahaṃsa ādhya samāyā ati sā
dhyavān na atra saṃśayaḥ etat yaṃtram samālikhya bhūrja patre vi
śeṣatas madhuka lasam samānīya kuryāt sādhya ākṛtim vām
yaṃtram saṃpūjayitvā tu tad kuśau saṃniveśayet
pya dīpe rūpam pratāpayet dīpe tasya japet nityam sādhya nāma
samanvitam śīghram āyāti yuvatī madana ākula mānasā
vāma pāda rajaḥ grāhya tasmin maṃtram samālikhet sādhya nāma
samāyuktam japet aṣṭa sahasrakam sadyas sa adya samāyāti na saṃde
hotra vidyate vighneśvaram samāsādya saṃpūjya vidhi pūrvakam sā
pṛ0 20a dhyam smṛtvā japet mantra samāyāti na saṃśayaḥ iti śrī kaumāra
saṃhitāyām caturthaḥ udhyāyaḥ atha atas saṃpravakṣyāmi staṃbhanam
maṃtra akṣarā
madhyatas prāṇa saṃsthāpanam
tu āsādhya nāma samanvitam pūjayet sapta rātram tu pīta puṣpaiḥ vi
śeṣatas
rātre japet nityam aṣṭottarasahasra kaṃraṇa bhūmau likhet yaṃtram valim
pṛ0 20ada tvā viśeṣataḥ senā staṃbham samāyāti catur aṅga samanvitā
nagaram nagara aṃtasthā sabhā madhye sabhā saraḥ kṣetreṣu śalabha ādī
nimārge cora mṛgān api staṃbhayet sakalān atra mātra kāryā
vicāraṇā vṛṣabhasya sakṛt grahya yāvat bhūma sanā patanāt puras piṃḍā
atas dagdhvā bhaumavāre viśeṣataḥ yaṃtram bhasma ani saṃlih
khya sādhya nāma samanvitaḥ prāṇa pratīṣṭām kṛtvā atu pīta pu
samarcayet kuṃkumena samālikhya japet aṣṭa sahasrakam
śikhāyām dhārayet yantram loka staṃbhana saṃśayaḥ gaja yuddhe meṣa yuddhe
nara yuddhena parasparam yaṃtra dhāraṇa mātreṇa staṃbhanam pratiyoginaḥ
ṛ aha uktena rahasyam śṛṇu padmaja ānaya iti ma
nuṣyāṇān taṃbhaya iti pada dvayam sādhya nāma samāyuktam japet staṃ
bhana karmaṇi kevalam japa mātreṇa staṃbhayet na atra saṃśayaḥ
ṇu vrahman pravakṣyāmi śatroḥ uccāṭanam param pūrva dyaṃtra māli
khya sādhya nāma pade likhet maṃtra akṣarāṇi sarvāṇi vāyu
pṛ0 21ba vījena veṣṭayet prāṇa saṃsthāpanam kṛtvā kṛṣṇa puṣpaiḥ samarca
ye tsaṃpūjya nava rātram tu nityam aṣṭa sahasrakam jīrṇa patrā
ṇi saṃgṛhya tṛṇa vartta utthita anica śmasāna nīlikā mū
laṃ rathavarttasya mūlakam karavīrasya parṇāni sarvam
sare kulikā udaya velāyām durggā kālī ālaye haret tad bha
sma kṛṣṇa vastreṇa saṃgṛhyāt yaṃtra pūrvakam vibhītaka tvacā ava
dhvā śatru gehe vinikṣipet śatruḥ svam vaṃdhubhiḥ sārddham
pṛ0 22a tara gataḥ bhava iti atra kutra api saṃsthāpyam tat tat uccāṭayet
ccāṭana padam proktā kevalam japa mātrataḥ uccāṭanam bhavet sadyas
trūṇām na atra saṃśayaḥ iti śrī kaumārasaṃhitāyāḥ
kopa kāra artham pravakṣeka malān aviśeṣeṇa nṛpāṇām ca sarvasā
mrājya dāyakam yaṃtra taṃtra vinā sadyas sarva karmāṇi sādhitum
homam vakṣyāmi devasya vidyā gaṇapateḥ vibhoḥ vidhāya homa
kuṃḍam tu catur asram tri mekhalam aratni mātram dviguṇam kuryāt karma anu
rūpataḥ svārthe hi aratni mātram syāt parārthe dviguṇam bhavet devāḥ
laye para arthe ced sva arthe ced nija veśma nikuṃḍe vahu samādāya
samṛhya parivicya cakuryāt api mukham vrahman kartuḥ sūtra anu
ācārya sūtreṇa eva apikuryāt agni mukha kriyāṃ kuṇḍe
siṃhāsanam dhyātvā pīṭhe kuryāt anukramāt pūrva ukta mārgeṇa abhya
rcya dhyātvā a vidyā garaṇa īśvaram gaṇānām tvā iti ca āvāhya mūlamaṃtre
pādya ādi kanda tvā gandha puṣpaiḥ samarcayet
pṛ0 23a
lī phala ādyān nivedya ca aṣṭottaraśatam vrahman kuryāt ājya āhutim
sudhīḥ ṣoḍaśa nālikerānām dviguṇam kadalī phalam śarka
rājapṛthuka modakaiḥ madhu sarpiṣā aṣṭa dravyāṇi saṃyojya
hute dakṣara saṃkṣayā akṣarāṇām sahasram ca maṃḍalam homayet su
dhī nava araṇa pūjām cakṛtvā bhakti puraḥsaram sarvān kāmā
na vāpnoti vighna īśaḥ su prasīdati putra arthī vahu putrān ca dha
na arthī dhana saṃpadaḥ nigaḍāt ca vimucyeta mahā rogāt ca rogi
naḥ yaṃ yaṃ prārthya hute vrahman vaśam āpnoti tad kṣaṇāt saṃde
honā atra kartavyaḥ satyam evam vadāmi aham ayutam padma puṣpaiḥ
śca homayet vā a vibhūtaye jāti puṣpaiḥ yajet vidvān rāja
vaśyena saṃśayaḥ kuṭajaiḥ caṃpakaiḥ hutvā mahat aiścaryam āpnu
yāt karavīrasya puṣpeṇa hute śatru vināśanam rakta varṇaiḥ
r hute vrahman kṣauma vastra ādi labhya te huta itmā ālasya hunetmī lalya puṣpāṇi
pṛ0 24a bhūṣaṇa ādīni labh tejapā puṣpa homena vighneśaḥ su prasīd
dati kauśeya puṣpaiḥ hutvā atu yoga siddhim avāpnuyāt pī
ta puṣpaiḥ hu tit nityam vairi vāc staṃbhanam bhavet arkapuṣpeṇa hu
tvātuśatroḥ tāpa jvaraḥ bhavet unmatta puṣpaiḥ hutvā āturipo
runmāda kāraṇam lāja trimadhuram hutvā sarva vaśyā karam bhavet
kahlāra upala homena rāja strī vaśya tām vrajet daridra cū
homam tu trailokyam staṃbhanam bhavet dūrvā yugmam hutet sadyas
pṛ0 24a rva roga vināśanam guḍucya yuta homena mṛtaḥ vā api sa jīvan eti
ājya miśra tilaiḥ hutvā ripu nāśaḥ na saṃśayaḥ paramātmena ju
huyāt aṣṭottaraśaṃtam sudhīḥ maṃḍalena bhavet nūnam paśudhānya
samṛddhimān vighneśa homam kṛtvā tu paścāt sarva samārabhet
vinā vighneśa homena karma tat niṣphalam bhava iti ti śrī
kaumārasaṃhitāyām ṣaṣṭaḥ adhyāyaḥ bhūpatīnām hita arthā
ya home vakṣyāmi padmaja kevalam homa mātreṇa srava sāmrā
jya dāyakam gaja vṛddhi karam śrīmat aśva vṛddhi karam param
ddhi karam ca eva ātma vṛddhi karam tathā etat sarvam bhavet vrahman i
tya homāt na saṃśayaḥ nitya homam tu vakṣyāmi yathāvat katha
yā mite aratni dvaya mātre tu kuṃḍe saṃsthāpya pāvakam kuṃḍasya
ttara bhāge tu kuṃbham ekam vinikṣipet vighneśa pratimām kuryāḥ
dvātriṃśa aṃgula saṃkhyayā prāṇa saṃsthāpanam kṛtvā āsthāpya kuṃḍe
gaṇeśvaram gaṃdha puṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya dhūpa dīpam prakalpayet naivedyam
pṛ0 25ba dyam vidhivat kṛtvā pāyasa apūpa modakaiḥ tām kathaṃca nivedyā
tha jātaḥ homam samācaret vedikā agni mukham kṛtvā pīṭha pūjām
vidhāya ca āvāhya ca gaṇa adhīśam da tvā ca arghya ādikam ta
thā saṃpūjya vidyā gaṇa paṃnava āvaraṇa pūrvakam ājya āhutim
tatas kuryāt śatam aṣṭa uttaraḥ tathā ācāryaḥ tu atha homa aṃtam kṛ
tvātu vidhi pūrvakam ṛtvijām caturbhiḥ tu homa karma sarmā ca
retaṣṭa dravyaiḥ hute vrahma naṣṭottarasasrakam paścāt ājya āhutim
pṛ0 26a
pūrvakam prasanna pūjām saṃkalpya pāyasa apūpa modakaiḥ
yaiḥ pānaka ādyaiḥ ca vighnarājam prapūjayet tatas puṣpa aṃjalim kṛ
tvā paśu mudrām pradarśayet stotre stutvā gaṇādhīśam dhyātvā
cit mayam avyayam vāma nāsā puṭena eva hṛd padme yojayet prabhum
puṣpaiḥ ātmānam abhyarcya yathāśakti japet prabhum yajamānaḥ tu
homa aṃte vinayena samanvitaḥ vighneśvaram homakuṃḍam ācārya
pṛ0 26a
tvijām tu tathā dadyāt nityam bhakti puraḥsaram ācāryāya dviguṇi
tam ṛtvijāya samam samam vrāhmaṇān bhojayet nityam samabhyarcya
dine dine evam evam ca homena sarva kārya artha siddhaye āyuḥ vṛ
mṛtyuḥ vināśanam pūrva ukta sarva karmāṇi sa
phalāni na saṃśayaḥ saṃgrāma vijayam vakṣe sarva śatru nivarhaṇam
saṃgrāma samaye nityam samāvāhya gaṇeśvaram homaśālām prakurvī
pṛ0 27a
vitāna darpaṇa ubhrāja kadalī toraṇa anvitam tad madhye homa
kuṃḍam tu dviguṇam nitya kuṃḍataḥ mekhalā traya saṃyuktam kartu ratni samam
taḥ kuṃbhasya uttara bhāge tu sthāpayet kuṃbha paṃcakam vighneśaḥ prati
mām kuryām dviguṇān iti a homataḥ prāṇa saṃsthāpanam kṛtvā kuṃḍam
dhye pranikṣipet arcayet gaṃdha puṣpa ādyaiḥ dhūpa dīpaiḥ prapūjayet
naivedyam vidhivat kṛtvā homa karma samāpayeta ācāryaḥ tu śu
pṛ0 27ba ciḥ bhūtvā kṣauma vastra uttarīyakaḥ kūrmāsanam samāsthāya kuryāḥ
nyājapa ādi kaṃkuṃḍe vahni pratisthāpya kuryāt agnimukham kramā
tā āgama agni mukham kṛtvā tatas vaimūlavidyayā aṣṭa uttara saha
sraṃtu kuryāt ājya āhutim vidhe ṛtvigbhiḥ daśabhiḥ sārddham aṣṭa
masya āhutim hutet nityam ṣoḍaśa sāhasram homayet vidhi pūrvakam
pratyekam tu japam kuryāt nityam aṣṭa uttaram śatam kuṃḍasya paścime bhā
ge taṃḍule maṃḍite vidho grahān prapūjayet nityam āditya ādi
pṛ0 28a yathākramam pāyasa annaiḥ apūpaiḥ ca vighneśāya nivedaye taṣṭo
ttara sahasram tu rātrau kuryāt tu tarpaṇam ṛtvigbhiḥ jāpayet maṃtram
ṣṭottarasahasrakam vibhītaka samidbhiḥ ca homayet ayuta trayam
vaṃ maṃḍala homena nūnam śatru palāyanam vighneśvara prasādena śatru
menā praṇaśyati vrāhmaṇān bhojayet nityam vighneśam apipūja
ye thoma aṃte dakṣiṇām dadyāt gaṃdha puṣpaiḥ samarcayeta ācāryā
yaśatam niṣkam ṛtvigbhyaḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ kramāt ukta saṃgrāma vija
pṛ0 28ba yam sadyas sāmrājya dāyakam sarva aiśvarya pradam divyam sarva śatru pa
lāyanam iti kaumārahitāyām saptamaḥ adhyāyaḥ saṃvat
jyeṣṭa kṛṣṇa śubham
